Each snapshot is a complete logical ZIP containing system.tar. The server stores
identical 4-MiB blocks only once per account/agent profile. Subsequent runs read the
sources again but transfer only new blocks. Insertions can shift subsequent block boundaries and cause additional transfers.

Backed up: System files, installed native programs, APT sources/keys,
Flatpak/Snap packages, all user homes including AppImages, pip/pipx/npm,
desktop settings, UID/GID, ACLs/xattrs, local applications, systemd units with
activation links, Cron, printers/Udev and further configurations. Additional
local drives must be explicitly selected. Network profiles with credentials only after selection. The backup contains sensitive system data!

system-inventory.json documents packages, Flatpak application sources,
user inventories, mounts, partition information, and capture errors.
Applications are restored during a full system restore as backed-up files along with the package database; no reinstallation from the internet.

Full restoration from Live-USB to prepared Linux target. Mount target partitions first. The partition layout may differ; /etc/fstab and /etc/crypttab remain preserved on the target. Configure bootloader/partitioning separately.
No sector image. For another distribution select the separate migration scope and install programs from appropriate target repositories. Additional files on the target are not deleted.
Stop running databases, VMs, and containers orderly beforehand; a file copy of a running application is not automatically consistent. Do not manually delete server blocks: multiple backup snapshots may use the same blocks.
Migration: Home im Live-System übernehme: Migration: restore the home in a live system. Then install programs on the running target (target /). Extra space for the unpacked system is required. Log out the target user before home migration.
Arbeitsablage: lokal oder auf Linux-Date: Work directory: local or on a Linux data disk; sufficient free space required
Zuerst mit dem eigenen Linux-Benutzer am: Sign in to the Manager with your own Linux account first.
Dieses Manager-Konto hat keine übernehmb: This Manager account has no Linux UID/GID that can be adopted.
UID/GID-Vorschau geladen. Noch nichts ge: UID/GID preview loaded. Nothing has changed.
Server-UID und Gruppen-ID übernehmen: Adopt server UID and primary GID
Die Umstellung erfolgt beim nächsten Neu: The conversion runs before login on the next reboot. File ownership and numeric ACLs are updated; username, password and client binding are retained. Network shares are not changed. All listed volumes must be mounted at boot. Startup may take longer. If the conversion fails, normal login remains blocked until the cause is resolved in recovery mode. Have a verified backup available first.
Ich habe eine aktuelle Sicherung und möc: I have a current backup and want to change my UID and primary GID.
UID/GID-Umstellung vorgemerkt. Beim näch: UID/GID conversion scheduled for next boot. The current IDs remain active until then.
UID und primäre GID stimmen bereits mit: UID and primary GID already match the server.
UID/GID weichen ab. Du kannst die Überna: UID/GID differ. You can check whether the server IDs can be adopted. Only that step requires administrator approval; the change is confirmed separately afterwards.
Server erreichbar · Lokale Client-Kennun: Server reachable · Local client identity cannot be read
Für den Vergleich mit dem Server mit dem: Sign in with your own Linux account to compare IDs with the server. A scheduled local change can be cancelled independently of the Manager login.
Die für den nächsten Neustart vorgemerkt: Cancel the UID/GID change scheduled for the next reboot? Changes already started will not be rolled back.
Vollständiges Linux-System statt nur eig: Back up the full Linux system instead of only my home data
Standard: eigenes Home ohne eingebundene: Default: your own home, excluding mounted drives. Additional disks and server shares are not included automatically.
Nur eigene Home-Daten auf den Server sic: Back up only your own home data to the server? Mounted drives and server shares remain excluded. This is a file backup, not a system backup.
Eigene Home-Daten auf den Server sichern: Back up my home data to the server (HTTPS)
Standard: vollständiges Linux-System mit: Default: full Linux system including programs, package sources, desktop and home. Additional data disks and server shares require explicit selection.
Zusätzliche Datenplatten oder Serverfrei: Additional data disks or server shares: mount points separated by ; (optional)
Zusätzliche Datenplatten / Serverfreigab: Select additional data disks / server shares
Zusätzliche Datenplatten und Serverfreig: Additional data disks and server shares
Zusatzablage muss ein direkt eingehängte: Additional storage must be a directly mounted supported filesystem.
Standard ist die vollständige Linux-Syst: The default is a full Linux system backup. Home or individual folders can alternatively be selected as file backups; these do not contain programs or system configuration. Additional data disks and server shares require explicit selection.
Am Manager anmelden / Konto wechseln: Sign in to Manager / switch account
Anmeldung übernommen. Sicherungsstatus e: Signed in. Check backup status again.
Ein vorhandener PC-Systemstand wird wied: An existing PC system snapshot is reused. Personal data stays separate for each user and is backed up incrementally. After system or application changes, explicitly refresh the shared snapshot. Other users must back up their own home.
Gemeinsamen PC-Systemstand neu sichern (: Refresh shared PC system snapshot (Manager administrator)
Gemeinsamen Systemstand aktualisieren: z: To refresh the shared system snapshot, sign in as a Manager administrator first.
Gemeinsamen Systemstand dieses PCs siche: Backing up the shared system snapshot of this PC …
Getrennte PC-Sicherung vom laufenden Cli: Start split PC backups from the running client. Back up offline sources using the USB wizard.
Getrennte PC-Sicherung: Systemstand ohne: Split PC backup: the system snapshot excludes normal user homes; personal snapshots contain only your own home. Restore system and personal snapshots separately. Partitioning and bootloader setup remain manual.
HTTPS: vorhandenen Systemstand prüfen, d: HTTPS: check the existing system snapshot, then read only your own personal data and transfer new blocks. Sign in as a Manager administrator for a new system snapshot. Shut down databases, VMs and containers cleanly first.
Manager benötigt die Erweiterung für gem: Manager needs the shared PC backup update.
Noch kein gemeinsamer Systemstand vorhan: No shared system snapshot exists yet. A Manager administrator must create it once; personal data is still backed up.
Nur die unvollständige gemeinsame System: Discard only this PC’s unfinished shared system upload? Stop running backups first. Completed snapshots are retained.
Nur persönliche Daten dieses Benutzers s: Backing up only this user’s personal data; reusing unchanged blocks …
PC-System und persönliche Daten getrennt: Select PC system and personal data separately. Shared system snapshots are visible only after signing in as a Manager administrator. Personal snapshots contain only the respective user’s home; restore the system first, then the personal snapshots you need.
PC-System und persönliche Daten sind get: PC system and personal data are stored separately. Other users’ homes were not backed up.
PC-Systemstand prüfen und wiederverwende: Check and reuse the PC system snapshot; back up only your own personal data separately. Other users’ homes stay excluded. New system snapshots require Manager administrator sign-in. Additional volumes are included only when creating a new system snapshot. No local intermediate archive. System and personal data are restored separately.
Persönliche Daten auf diesem PC übernehm: Restore personal data on this PC
Persönlichen Stand nur als Home, Einzeld: Restore a personal snapshot only as home data, individual files or personal migration.
Standard: gemeinsamer PC-Systemstand und: Default: shared PC system snapshot and separate personal data. Additional data disks and server shares are included only when selected for an explicitly refreshed system snapshot.
Zusätzliche Datenträger oder Netzwerkpro: Additional volumes or network profiles selected: explicitly refresh the shared PC system snapshot.
Gültige PC-Kennung erforderlich. Client: A valid PC identity is required. Update and pair the client.
Benutzer und PC zuerst im Manager koppel: Pair user and PC in Manager first.
Gemeinsamer Systemstand: Manager-Adminis: Shared system snapshot: sign in as a Manager administrator.
Gemeinsamer Systemstand fehlt oder wurde: Shared system snapshot is missing or has been removed.
Unsicherer Benutzer-Home-Pfad; vor gemei: Unsafe normal-user home; review before shared system backup.
Persönliche Sicherung benötigt einen nor: Personal system backup requires a normal user with a home below /home.
Das persönliche Home liegt auf einer Net: Personal Home is a network mount; explicit separate backup required.
Persönliche Sicherung benötigt den laufe: Personal backup requires the running client.
Zusätzliche gemeinsame Datenträger müsse: Explicit shared volumes must be outside user homes. Back up personal home data separately.
Abbruch angefordert. Laufenden Abschnitt: Cancellation requested. Finishing the current section and cleaning up the unfinished snapshot …
Abbruch angefordert; Server-Aufräumen ni: Cancellation requested; server cleanup was not confirmed. Discard the unfinished upload later.
Abbruch kam nach dem Abschluss; fertige: Cancellation arrived after completion; the completed backup is retained.
Lokale Sicherung abgebrochen; unvollstän: Local backup cancelled; unfinished file removed.
Sicherung abgebrochen; unvollständige Üb: Backup cancelled; unfinished upload removed. Completed snapshots are retained.
Abbruch angefordert; vorhandener Systems: Cancellation requested; the existing system snapshot is retained. Personal upload was not started.
Abbrechen stoppt nur die gewählte Übertr: Cancellation stops only the selected upload. Completed snapshots are retained. The client receives a cancellation error with its next section.
Gemeinsamen PC-Systemstand neu sichern (: Back up the shared PC system snapshot again (permission required)
Unvollständige PC-Systemübertragung verw: Discard incomplete PC system upload (permission required)
Gemeinsamen Systemstand aktualisieren: a: Update the shared system snapshot: sign in as an administrator or with system backup permission.
Noch kein gemeinsamer Systemstand vorhan: No shared system snapshot exists yet. An administrator or authorized user must create it; personal data will still be backed up.
HTTPS: vorhandenen Systemstand prüfen, d: HTTPS: check the existing system snapshot, then back up your personal data. New system snapshots require manager administrator rights or explicit system backup permission. Stop databases/VMs/containers cleanly first.
PC-Systemstand prüfen und wiederverwende: Check and reuse the PC system snapshot; back up only your own personal data separately. Other user homes remain excluded. New system snapshots require administrator rights or explicit user permission. Additional volumes are included only in a new system snapshot. No local intermediate archive. System and personal data are restored separately.
PC-System und persönliche Daten getrennt: Select PC system and personal data separately. Shared system snapshots are visible to administrators or explicitly authorized users. Personal snapshots contain only the respective user’s home; restore the system first, then the personal snapshots you need.
